mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 31 degrees at Fireman's Park with clear skies and a lovely waning crescent moon overhead.

City residents should prepare for pavement repairs on November 10 and 11, affecting areas like Morningside Boulevard, Mozart Street, and Todd Street, with no parking allowed from 7 AM to 7 PM. Additionally, the Plan Commission is reviewing new development projects for Liberty Business Park on December 7.

Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market at the Capitol Square or enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, Lake Lou-ee hosts live music tomorrow, and Insight Wellness has yoga classes on November 9.
In a noteworthy incident from the past week, on October 23, police contacted two 13-year-olds riding electric motorcycles on Ashton Drive, resulting in citations for their parents.
Today's delicious flavor is Andes Mint Avalanche. The store is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM to serve you.
